name: floating_voltage_source
description: A 3 V source between two non-ground nodes, in series with resistors. By hand this needs a supernode; MNA handles it with one extra unknown.
derivation: One loop: 10 V source, R1 (1k), V2 (3 V, + at b), R2 (2k). Constraint: b - c = 3. Same current I through R1 and R2: (10-b)/1k = c/2k = (b-3)/2k, so 20 - 2b = b - 3, b = 23/3 V, c = 14/3 V, I = 7/3 mA. Current enters V2 at + (b), so V2 reports +7/3 mA (it opposes the main source).
